title: AI helped me debug this multiplayer cross-platform game. I had so many bugs I gave up on it many times
author: avioane

comments.author: avioane
comments.body:
You can play it at [battleplanes.itch.io/battle-planes](http://battleplanes.itch.io/battle-planes)

I'm a solo dev from Romania. Battle Planes Multiplayer is my version of "Avioane", the pen-and-paper game we played in school (in China it's called 炸飞机). You hide 3 planes on a 10x10 grid, and hitting a plane's head takes the whole plane down. Matches take 1–5 minutes, and you can play vs the computer, online, or with a friend by code, with cross-play between Steam, Android and web.

Where AI helped:

Buuuugs. OMG the bugs were unbelievable. 

* **Art:** backgrounds
* **Voice lines:** the announcer and turn voices were AI-generated. I'm planning to re-record them myself in Romanian and English and get the help of a native Chinese voice actor.
* **Code and porting:**  AI help with Unity/C#, the backend, the WebGL build

Let me know any feedback
